name: com.tamperlens/mcp
description: Was this document edited, did its redactions hold, is it safe for a model to read — Tamperlens API.

environmentVariables.name: TAMPERLENS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the anonymous allowance applies (10 documents/hour); a free key from tamperlens.com/account raises it. compare_documents requires a key.

environmentVariables.name: TAMPERLENS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Defaults to the public deployment at https://tamperlens.com.
